description: This file defines an OpenAIPassthroughLoggingHandler class that handles cost tracking, logging, and response processing for OpenAI proxy endpoints such as chat completions, image generation, and responses API. It includes methods for identifying OpenAI-specific routes, calculating costs, handling streaming responses, and integrating with a logging system.
